Mano, once an immature and possessive college boy, loses his first love Kodi, a bold and caring girl from a traditional Coimbatore family, after his insecurities and long-distance struggles ruin their relationship. Years later, Mano, now more mature, meets Nivi, an independent, lower-middle-class girl raised by a single mother, who is recovering from a toxic relationship with Arul.
